However, it is not a reconstruction of the reported alloy strategy. It also gives only an approximate 10^3 s^-1 regime, does not specify SHPB loading at 4000 s^-1 in air, and provides no quantitative or literature-supported prediction. Although the experiment could test the alternative concept in principle, the lack of processing parameters and evidence prevents treating it as a well-supported plausible alternative.
